Cc: NimbleRx Procurement <procurement@nimblerx.com>
Date: Thu, 8 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: interim sandbox access while PO clears

Hi Olga —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Our team is excited and we’re ready to move to a pilot, but procurement has flagged some contract language and the PO routing is expected to take 10–12 business days. I attached the draft PO so you can see where it stands.

Is there a way for you to keep the sandbox live for our engineers while procurement finishes? Ideally we’d have another 7–10 days of access or a small interim credit so our integration work doesn’t stall. We don’t need increased capacity — just continuity for the environment and API keys.

I can escalate on our side, but wanted to ask if Redwood can sponsor a short-lived token/credit or extend the trial window while the PO clears. If you need an exec contact, Marcus Lane (copied) is on procurement.

Thanks — appreciate any flexibility.

Emily Rogers
Head of Integrations, NimbleRx
emily@nimblerx.com
(415) 555-0198

Hi Emily —

Really glad the demo went well — thanks for the clear context. We can definitely help avoid a gap while procurement works through the PO. Proposed short-term options:

- 7 days of sponsored sandbox credits (small token bucket; no change to account billing)
- Temporary API key with limited quota for integration testing
- Freeze of the trial countdown for up to 10 days while PO is in flight (requires finance sign-off)

I’m attaching a SOC2 excerpt and will loop in finance + CS to make the admin changes. Can you confirm the expected PO clearance date? Also confirm you only need sandbox access (no additional dedicated seats).

If that looks good I’ll ask David to greenlight the sponsorship and Kimberly to provision the key.

Best,
